opening.argument: The presentation centers on an unusually low-barrier promise: viewers are told that “just in every 5 minute you will click a button and you will receive Rs. 43 That too without any investment.” It then directs them through an application link, browser forms, a CAPTCHA, sign-in and the application’s timed clicking process, where viewers are told to start the timer and wait five minutes. The displayed screens reinforce a reward structure through cloud-mining balances, a 0.01 BTC withdrawal threshold, and referral rewards supported by invite and copy-link controls. These features present cryptocurrency earnings as readily obtainable through repeated clicks and recruitment. Yet the available evidence does not establish actual mining or payment, and the destination’s operation and control remain uncertain, which further undermines the credibility of the promised rewards.
